talks.title: The bordism (∞,1)-category as a Morita category of stratified spaces
talks.abstract: Joint work in progress with David Ayala and John Francis approaches the bordism (∞,1)-category through a Morita category built from stratified spaces. Exponentiable fibrations and relative functor categories connect geometric bordisms with higher categorical structure. This perspective supplies a foundation for constructing topological quantum field theories via β-factorization homology.

talks.title: A combinatorial approach to Morita categories
talks.venue: Hodge Club · University of Edinburgh · 15 November 2024
talks.abstract: A self-contained introduction to Rune Haugseng’s combinatorial construction of higher Morita categories of Eₙ-algebras and their role in topological quantum field theory. The talk introduces non-symmetric ∞-operads and explains Lurie–Dunn additivity, building the background needed to understand these higher algebraic structures.
